name: firelight-site
description: Firelight promo site, deployed to https://roboz0r.github.io/Firelight/

scripts.dev: dotnet fable watch ./Renderer -o ./build/Renderer -s --run dotnet fable watch ./ -o ./build/ -s --run vite
scripts.build:site: npm run build:renderer && dotnet fable ./ -o ./build/ --run vite build
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run check:template && npm run build:demos && npm run build:site && npm run build:search
